answer: Use bond-gated admission: a validator seat is earned only by locking a bond sized above the marginal revenue of one Sybil identity. Minting N fake identities means posting N bonds at once, so sunk cost grows linearly while per-key yield stays flat. Weight is paid per unit of bond, not per address, so splitting stake across keys changes nothing, and shared-funding detection lets one slashing event hit the whole cluster. A harbor of cheap accounts becomes an expensive voyage: each extra key needs a costly onyx stake the attacker cannot recoup.
